subject.title: Feature Request: Extract text from document attachments in Telegram channel

question: Should OpenClaw support Office-style document extraction for Telegram attachments through the bundled/shared document-extractor path, and what parser, MIME scope, and resource limits are acceptable?
rationale: Current code intentionally skips Office containers before extraction, VISION.md prefers plugin boundaries for optional capability, and parsing untrusted document containers changes the security and availability boundary.

options.title: Approve narrow shared extraction
options.body: Add maintainer-approved DOCX-first support through the document-extractor/media-understanding path with explicit MIME allowlists, archive/XML limits, tests, docs, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Extend external plugin seam first
options.body: Keep core behavior unchanged until external document-extractor plugins can safely own Office formats through ClawHub without bundled core changes.

options.title: Defer Office extraction
options.body: Keep text/PDF behavior only and document Office files as unsupported until a broader file/document input direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow shared extraction
recommendation.body: Add maintainer-approved DOCX-first support through the document-extractor/media-understanding path with explicit MIME allowlists, archive/XML limits, tests, docs, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The central remaining work extends the media/input_file and document-extractor seams recently changed in this area.
